Security.title: Security and Control
Security.description: Tenant isolation, authorization, and traceability. Your data under your control.
Security.principle1_desc: Each business operates in isolation within its own data. Tenant scope is mandatory for all queries. Access limits are protected at the application level.
Security.principle2_desc: Permissions are separated by roles. Critical actions depend on roles. Least privilege principle by default.
Security.principle3_desc: Actions such as rule changes, cancellations, or reschedules are recorded. Operational tracking becomes easier.
Security.principle4_desc: Backup and recovery plans are kurgulanır at a basic level. Access restrictions are applied for sensitive data.
Security.principle5_desc: Session management is handled securely. Request limits reduce the risk of abuse.

FAQ.title: Frequent Questions
FAQ.description: Clear answers about setup, slot logic, security, and billing.
FAQ.a1: Basic setup in MVP is done in minutes. You add branches/services/staff and define rules. We can also proceed with setup support if you wish.
FAQ.q2: How does the slot logic work?
FAQ.a2: Slots are generated based on availability hours and service durations. Leave days and special closures automatically narrow the slots. This way, you don't do manual calculations.
FAQ.a3: Conflict check is performed at the moment of selection and a second appointment is not allowed for the same slot. Consistency is maintained with a locking logic at the application level.
FAQ.q4: Is there a cancellation and rescheduling flow?
FAQ.a4: Appointment cancellation/rescheduling flow is supported in MVP. Changes are recorded and can be monitored in the panel.
FAQ.a5: Yes. You can separate staff and services based on branches and see reporting with branch filters. Each branch manages its own operation more clearly.
FAQ.q6: How do I manage staff leaves?
FAQ.a6: You define leave/closed days with time-off records. Slot generation automatically takes these records into account. This way, the calendar does not fall apart.
FAQ.a7: The infrastructure design is set up to be ready. Some channels may be opened as 'soon' in MVP. We determine the priority according to your needs.
FAQ.q8: Can I migrate my existing data?
FAQ.a8: Yes, basic data (branch/staff/service) can be imported. We clarify the format and create a short migration plan.
FAQ.q9: What is included in terms of security?
FAQ.a9: Tenant isolation and role-based authorization are core principles. Audit logs are kept for critical actions. Applicable controls are offered instead of exaggerated promises.
FAQ.a10: There is a monthly/yearly plan structure and upgrading plans is easy. Net prices are shared on the plan screen. Setup and support options may vary by plan.
FAQ.q11: Will I be able to receive support?
FAQ.a11: A support channel is provided during the setup and usage process. Faster returns are targeted in the Pro plan. Onboarding can be done as needed.
FAQ.q12: Can it be used on mobile?
FAQ.a12: Yes. The panel is designed to be mobile-first and basic operations are handled comfortably on mobile. 3D demo is for visual support; critical operations are done from the 2D panel.
